metadata.description: Wire format for `vibe self source [show] --json` (`vibe-self-source/1`, PROP-019 `#release-sources`): the effective release source, the input that decided it, and the one `[[remap]]` row it installs. The whole document is the shared `release_source_view` vocabulary, which `vibe-self-releases/1` carries verbatim as its `source` member. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/self_source_report/mod.rs`.
